name: Minneapolis Park Board Youth Advisory Council
what_you_do: Serve on a youth council. It gives feedback on Park Board programs and processes. Members plan community events and build leadership and research skills. They explore careers. They help guide anti-violence outreach.
who_can_apply: Youth leaders ages 14 to 17. Members serve a two year term.
pay_detail: Pay is not stated on the page. The page says members get support with professionalism, financial literacy and customer service.
duration: Two year term, 5 to 12 hours a month
deadline_text: No application dates are posted on the council page.
how_to_apply: The page does not explain how to apply. Contact Adrian Waters at Awaters@minneapolisparks.org or 612-849-9048 to ask when the next group is chosen.
notes: The teen programs page calls it a select group. Confirm how to apply and whether it is paid before you plan around it.
